families.notes: The painting shows hills as meadow with scrub and no visible relief; the rocky rises belong to mountain and mount.
Mud is painted as crater rims and churned, stony ground; stone as meadow strewn with grey boulders.
Single small rocky knolls with grassy slopes.
Four-hex grassy massifs with bare rock along the crest.
Boulder shore between lake and meadow. The painted lake is larger than the level's, so r27c7 and r28c7 show open water.

features.title: Northern headquarters
features.notes: A walled fortress with four round corner towers, a red-roofed gatehouse and inner hall. The road enters through the north gate over the stream bridge.

features.title: Southern headquarters
features.notes: The same fortress layout as in the north, reached by the road through its north gate.

features.title: Central depot
features.notes: A fenced depot at the end of the road: barrier gate, sheds and red vehicles to the west, white tents to the east and a large hall with a helipad roof to the south.

features.title: Southwestern depot
features.notes: A second depot with the same fenced layout, entered from the road in the north.

features.title: Northern crater
features.notes: A round shell crater with a raised, cracked earth rim, trailing into stony, churned ground to the south.

features.title: Southern crater pair
features.notes: Two overlapping craters in bare earth. The western rim reaches into the meadow hex r40c4.

features.title: Lake with rocky shore
features.notes: Clear blue water ringed by rounded boulders, with a cluster of rocks rising from the water in the middle.

features.title: Northern stream with road bridge
features.notes: A stream with stony banks winds past the headquarters. The paved road crosses it on a concrete bridge.

features.title: Lake outlet with footbridges
features.notes: The lake drains into a winding creek. Two plank bridges cross it, one diagonal at the outlet and one straight further south.

features.title: Central massif
features.notes: A broad grassy massif with a bare rocky crest, and a small knoll on its northern side.

features.title: Eastern massif
features.notes: A smaller grassy massif with rock outcrops next to the lake shore.

features.title: Southwestern massif
features.notes: Grassy ridges with a deep rocky gully at the map corner.

features.title: Eastern knolls
features.notes: Two small rocky knolls above boulder-strewn meadow.

features.title: Northern huts
features.notes: Two detached huts with small sheds in open meadow.

features.title: Northern road junction
features.notes: The north-south road splits into a western branch and a long diagonal toward the central depot. Grey asphalt with dashed centre lines and gravel shoulders.

features.title: Western road junction
features.notes: The earth track from the north ends at a T-junction where one road turns south to the depot and another runs southeast.
